title: State judge orders Kalshi to stop offering sports bets and other wagers
summary: A state court in Washington this week ordered Kalshi to stop offering sports gambling and a variety of other wagers on its prediction market. McHale concluded that the US Commodity Exchange Act does not preempt Washington state gambling law.
